items.title: Gilead and Vir forge $1.9bn pact to develop next-gen T-cell engagers
items.summary: This deal sees Gilead double down on TCEs, following its first bet on the modality through its buyout of autoimmune-focused Ouro Medicines.

items.title: Rare disease regulation reaches “inflection point” with new FDA framework
items.summary: The tailored framework arrives amid renewed focus on rare diseases across US health agencies.

items.title: QCi and INmune Bio partner to study XPro in Alzheimer’s
items.summary: INmune Bio and QCi have agreed to collaborate using quantum computing, AI, and data analytics to explore new indications for XPro, an investigational treatment for Alzheimer's disease and other medical conditions.

items.title: ImmunityBio’s bladder cancer drug, Anktiva lands US label expansion
items.summary: Anktiva’s newfound FDA label expansion comes as the agency deems cases of CIS and high-grade papillary only NMIBC clinically similar.

items.title: Alentis and PinotBio partner to develop claudin-1 oncology ADCs
items.summary: Alentis Therapeutics and PinotBio have entered into a research collaboration and licensing agreement to develop claudin-1-targeting antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for oncology indications.
